# Reporting query plans and performance baseline

Generated by `scripts/run-reporting-performance-baseline.ps1`. Every figure below is measured against a real PostgreSQL 18 cluster, not estimated.

## Fixture

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Captured at (UTC) | 2026-08-19 08:38:12Z |
| Clients / websites / environments | 6 / 24 / 48 |
| Endpoints | 96 |
| Monitors | 192 |
| Check results | 1,667,520 |
| History retained | 90 days |
| Iterations per scenario | 10 |

## Measured latency

| Scenario | Fastest | Median | P95 | Slowest | NFR-02 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Dashboard - unfiltered, 30 days | 2,290 ms | 2,377 ms | 2,673 ms | 2,673 ms | within budget |
| Dashboard - one client, 30 days | 555 ms | 611 ms | 701 ms | 701 ms | within budget |
| Dashboard - unfiltered, 90 days | 5,302 ms | 6,115 ms | 7,585 ms | 7,585 ms | **over budget** |
| Dashboard - viewer scoped to one client, 30 days | 536 ms | 625 ms | 735 ms | 735 ms | within budget |
| CSV export - unfiltered, 30 days | 533 ms | 582 ms | 674 ms | 674 ms | not a dashboard |
| Report dataset - unfiltered, 90 days | 5,828 ms | 6,231 ms | 7,133 ms | 7,133 ms | not a dashboard |

## Plans

Captured with `auto_explain` (`log_analyze`, `log_buffers`, `log_nested_statements`), so each plan is the one PostgreSQL chose for the statement the application issued. The durations inside a plan include per-node instrumentation and are therefore higher than the measured latency above.

### Dashboard - unfiltered, 30 days

The default landing view: every monitor the reader can see, over the default window.

duration: 665.491 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT
	    NULL::uuid AS monitor_id,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Healthy') AS healthy_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Warning') AS warning_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Critical') AS down_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT result.counts_for_uptime) AS excluded_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS responded_samples,
	    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p50_ms,
	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms,
	    max(result.measured_at) AS last_measured_at,
	    min(result.monitor_source) AS lowest_source,
	    max(result.monitor_source) AS highest_source
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3

duration: 1199.051 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT
	    array_agg(DISTINCT result.monitor_source) AS monitor_sources,
	    min(snapshot.configuration_fingerprint) AS lowest_fingerprint,
	    max(snapshot.configuration_fingerprint) AS highest_fingerprint
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	JOIN web_health.check_configuration_snapshot AS snapshot
	  ON snapshot.logical_check_id = result.logical_check_id
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3
	  AND result.counts_for_uptime

duration: 83.490 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT
	    result.endpoint_monitor_id AS monitor_id,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Healthy') AS healthy_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Warning') AS warning_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Critical') AS down_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT result.counts_for_uptime) AS excluded_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS responded_samples,
	    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p50_ms,
	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms,
	    max(result.measured_at) AS last_measured_at,
	    min(result.monitor_source) AS lowest_source,
	    max(result.monitor_source) AS highest_source
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3
	GROUP BY result.endpoint_monitor_id

	    (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,

	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms

	    WHEN e4.endpoint_monitor_id IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
	    ELSE e4.confirmed_status
	END, e4.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = s.id0 AND i.status = ANY ($1))
	FROM (
	    SELECT e1.id AS id0, e1.endpoint_id, e1.monitor_type, e2.display_url AS display_url0, e2.owner_subject_id AS owner_subject_id0, e3.is_production, e3.name, w.name AS name0, w.owner_subject_id AS owner_subject_id1, c.name AS name1
	    FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	    INNER JOIN (
	        SELECT e0.id, e0.endpoint_id, e0.monitor_type
	        FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e0
	        WHERE e0.deleted_at IS NULL
	    ) AS e1 ON e.id = e1.endpoint_id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e2 ON e1.endpoint_id = e2.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e3 ON e2.environment_id = e3.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e3.website_id = w.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	    WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL
	    ORDER BY c.name, w.name, e3.name, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, e1.id
	    LIMIT $2
	) AS s
	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e4 ON s.id0 = e4.endpoint_monitor_id
	ORDER BY s.name1, s.name0, s.name, s.display_url0, s.monitor_type, s.id0

	Query Text: SELECT
	    NULL::uuid AS monitor_id,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Healthy') AS healthy_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Warning') AS warning_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Critical') AS down_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT result.counts_for_uptime) AS excluded_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS responded_samples,
	    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p50_ms,
	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms,
	    max(result.measured_at) AS last_measured_at,
	    min(result.monitor_source) AS lowest_source,
	    max(result.monitor_source) AS highest_source
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3

	Query Text: SELECT e1."Key" AS "Status", count(*)::int AS "Count"
	FROM (
	    SELECT COALESCE((
	        SELECT e0.confirmed_status
	        FROM web_health.endpoint_health AS e0
	        WHERE e0.endpoint_monitor_id = e.id
	        LIMIT 1), 'Unknown') AS "Key"
	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e
	    WHERE e.id = ANY ($1)
	) AS e1
	GROUP BY e1."Key"

	Query Text: SELECT
	    array_agg(DISTINCT result.monitor_source) AS monitor_sources,
	    min(snapshot.configuration_fingerprint) AS lowest_fingerprint,
	    max(snapshot.configuration_fingerprint) AS highest_fingerprint
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	JOIN web_health.check_configuration_snapshot AS snapshot
	  ON snapshot.logical_check_id = result.logical_check_id
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3
	  AND result.counts_for_uptime

duration: 368.038 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT
	    result.endpoint_monitor_id AS monitor_id,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Healthy') AS healthy_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Warning') AS warning_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Critical') AS down_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT result.counts_for_uptime) AS excluded_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS responded_samples,
	    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p50_ms,
	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms,
	    max(result.measured_at) AS last_measured_at,
	    min(result.monitor_source) AS lowest_source,
	    max(result.monitor_source) AS highest_source
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3
	GROUP BY result.endpoint_monitor_id

	    ELSE e4.confirmed_status
	END, e4.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = s.id0 AND i.status = ANY ($1))
	FROM (
	    SELECT e1.id AS id0, e1.endpoint_id, e1.monitor_type, e2.display_url AS display_url0, e2.owner_subject_id AS owner_subject_id0, e3.is_production, e3.name, w.name AS name0, w.owner_subject_id AS owner_subject_id1, c.name AS name1
	    FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	    INNER JOIN (
	        SELECT e0.id, e0.endpoint_id, e0.monitor_type
	        FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e0
	        WHERE e0.deleted_at IS NULL
	    ) AS e1 ON e.id = e1.endpoint_id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e2 ON e1.endpoint_id = e2.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e3 ON e2.environment_id = e3.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e3.website_id = w.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	    WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL
	    ORDER BY c.name, w.name, e3.name, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, e1.id
	    LIMIT $2
	) AS s
	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e4 ON s.id0 = e4.endpoint_monitor_id
	ORDER BY s.name1, s.name0, s.name, s.display_url0, s.monitor_type, s.id0

	Query Text: SELECT
	    NULL::uuid AS monitor_id,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Healthy') AS healthy_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Warning') AS warning_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Critical') AS down_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT result.counts_for_uptime) AS excluded_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS responded_samples,
	    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p50_ms,
	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms,
	    max(result.measured_at) AS last_measured_at,
	    min(result.monitor_source) AS lowest_source,
	    max(result.monitor_source) AS highest_source
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3

	    WHEN e4.endpoint_monitor_id IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
	    ELSE e4.confirmed_status
	END, e4.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = s.id0 AND i.status = ANY ($1))
	FROM (
	    SELECT e1.id AS id0, e1.endpoint_id, e1.monitor_type, e2.display_url AS display_url0, e2.owner_subject_id AS owner_subject_id0, e3.is_production, e3.name, w.name AS name0, w.owner_subject_id AS owner_subject_id1, c.name AS name1
	    FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	    INNER JOIN (
	        SELECT e0.id, e0.endpoint_id, e0.monitor_type
	        FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e0
	        WHERE e0.deleted_at IS NULL
	    ) AS e1 ON e.id = e1.endpoint_id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e2 ON e1.endpoint_id = e2.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e3 ON e2.environment_id = e3.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e3.website_id = w.id
	    INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	    WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL
	    ORDER BY c.name, w.name, e3.name, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, e1.id
	    LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
	) AS s
	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e4 ON s.id0 = e4.endpoint_monitor_id
	ORDER BY s.name1, s.name0, s.name, s.display_url0, s.monitor_type, s.id0

duration: 607.005 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT
	    result.endpoint_monitor_id AS monitor_id,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Healthy') AS healthy_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Warning') AS warning_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Critical') AS down_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT result.counts_for_uptime) AS excluded_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS responded_samples,
	    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p50_ms,
	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms,
	    max(result.measured_at) AS last_measured_at,
	    min(result.monitor_source) AS lowest_source,
	    max(result.monitor_source) AS highest_source
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3
	GROUP BY result.endpoint_monitor_id

	Query Text: SELECT
	    NULL::uuid AS monitor_id,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Healthy') AS healthy_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Warning') AS warning_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Critical') AS down_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT result.counts_for_uptime) AS excluded_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS responded_samples,
	    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p50_ms,
	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms,
	    max(result.measured_at) AS last_measured_at,
	    min(result.monitor_source) AS lowest_source,
	    max(result.monitor_source) AS highest_source
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3

	Query Text: SELECT
	    array_agg(DISTINCT result.monitor_source) AS monitor_sources,
	    min(snapshot.configuration_fingerprint) AS lowest_fingerprint,
	    max(snapshot.configuration_fingerprint) AS highest_fingerprint
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	JOIN web_health.check_configuration_snapshot AS snapshot
	  ON snapshot.logical_check_id = result.logical_check_id
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3
	  AND result.counts_for_uptime

duration: 392.366 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT
	    result.endpoint_monitor_id AS monitor_id,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime) AS eligible,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Healthy') AS healthy_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Warning') AS warning_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome = 'Critical') AS down_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT result.counts_for_uptime) AS excluded_samples,
	    count(*) FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS responded_samples,
	    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p50_ms,
	    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result.total_duration_ms)
	        FILTER (WHERE result.counts_for_uptime AND result.outcome IN ('Healthy', 'Warning')) AS p95_ms,
	    max(result.measured_at) AS last_measured_at,
	    min(result.monitor_source) AS lowest_source,
	    max(result.monitor_source) AS highest_source
	FROM web_health.check_result AS result
	WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	  AND result.measured_at >= $2
	  AND result.measured_at < $3
	GROUP BY result.endpoint_monitor_id
